steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Kaiser Wilhelm II became German Emperor (Kaiser) in June 1888 aged 29, following the death of his father Frederick III who had ruled for only 99 days. Wilhelm would reign until his abdication in November 1918.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Germany was a federal state with 25 states in 1871 (27 after 1912), each retaining its own ruler, government and laws. The Prussian King was automatically the German Kaiser.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Prussia was the largest and most powerful state in Germany. It covered 60% of German territory and contained 65% of the population. The King of Prussia was always the Kaiser.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Weltpolitik ("world policy") was Wilhelm II's aggressive foreign policy aiming to make Germany a major world power with colonies, a large navy, and international influence. It replaced Bismarck's Realpolitik ("practical politics") which had focused on maintaining peace and stability in Europe.

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Always use specific dates: Wilhelm became Kaiser in June 1888; the first Navy Law was 1898; the SPD won 110 seats in 1912 When evaluating the constitution, explain both democratic and autocratic features - don't just list one side For "how far" questions, always give a clear judgement at the end Link Weltpolitik to consequences: it was a CAUSE of Britain joining the Triple Entente The Zabern Affair (1913) is excellent evidence for showing the weakness of the Reichstag Remember: the SPD being the largest party proved the constitution was undemocratic - they had no power despite winning elections
